science: PHYSICS: nonlinear dynamics and chaos (Takens embedding, simplex projection, S-map)

formulas.definition: Simplex projection (Sugihara-May) on Takens delay vectors of the 33-dim occupation state, E in {1,2,3} lags chosen walk-forward by leave-one-out Pearson skill with Theiler window |s'-s|<=E; k=E*33+1 nearest (Euclidean), weights exp(-d/d1); ticket = top 7 forecast probabilities.
formulas.formula_text: x̂_{t+1} = Σ_j w_j x_{s_j+1}/Σ_j w_j over the k=33E*+1 nearest delay vectors (x_s..x_{s-E*+1}) to (x_t..x_{t-E*+1}), w_j=exp(-d_j/d_1), E*=argmax LOO ρ_E; pick top 7

formulas.definition: S-map (Sugihara 1994), E=1: weighted ridge regression x_{s+1} ~ [1, x_s], weights exp(-2 d/dbar) around the last draw, lambda=1 (intercept unpenalised); ticket = top 7 predicted values.
formulas.formula_text: ŷ = [1,x_t]·B, B = argmin Σ_s w_s||x_{s+1}-[1,x_s]B||² + ||B_{1:}||², w_s ∝ exp(-2||x_s-x_t||/mean||x_s-x_t||); pick top 7

formulas.definition: Poincare-section Takens embedding of the VAN drawing order: 11-dim order vector of each draw, k=12 nearest past analogues of the last draw (Euclidean on ball labels), weights exp(-d/d1); ticket = 11 numbers most frequent (weighted) in the analogues' next draws.
formulas.formula_text: score_i = Σ_{j≤12} exp(-d_j/d_1)·1[i ∈ draw(s_j+1)], d_j = ||order_{s_j} - order_t||₂ (12 nearest); pick top 11
